display.purpose: Hero headline in Gloock, resolving from blur.

readout.purpose: Live AQI numeral, tinted by CPCB category.

headline.purpose: Panel, band, results and ask titles.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat; --shadow-card is none. Depth is lightness steps and hairlines.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for state changes, rises and bar growth.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single amber action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid oklch(79% 0.145 68); border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(79% 0.145 68); color: oklch(19% 0.03 60); font: 650 1rem 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(79% 0.145 68) 86%, oklch(94% 0.012 80)); border-color: transparent; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(88% 0.12 200); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default outlined button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid oklch(60% 0.016 65); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: oklch(94% 0.012 80); font: 650 1rem 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(94% 0.012 80) 10%, transparent); border-color: oklch(84% 0.014 75); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(88% 0.12 200); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Labelled number or text input, darker than its panel.
components.html: Include children and elders.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-field label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 550; color: oklch(84% 0.014 75); } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(60% 0.016 65); border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(18% 0.012 55); color: oklch(94% 0.012 80); font: inherit; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: oklch(84% 0.014 75); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(88% 0.12 200); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-help { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: oklch(72% 0.016 70); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat lightness-step surface with a hairline; no shadow.
components.html:
Your household

Tell us about your home.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 40px; border: 1px solid oklch(40% 0.016 60); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(22.5% 0.014 55) 84%, transparent); color: oklch(94% 0.012 80); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 24px; font: 400 1.75rem/1.1 Gloock, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; }

components.name: AQI Readout
components.description: Large display-serif AQI numeral in its CPCB category colour with the category word.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px 16px; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid oklch(60% 0.016 65); color: oklch(71% 0.18 30); } .ds-num { font: 400 5rem/0.9 Gloock, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cat { font: 400 1.375rem Gloock, Georgia, serif; }

components.name: AQI Band Scale
components.description: Six CPCB band tiles tinted by category; the current band is brighter.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-scale { display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-band { flex: 1; min-height: 84px; padding: 12px; display: grid; align-content: end; border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 16%, oklch(22.5% 0.014 55)); color: oklch(84% 0.014 75); font: 650 0.8125rem 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-band.now { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 38%, oklch(22.5% 0.014 55)); color: oklch(94% 0.012 80); }

components.name: Exposure Bars
components.css: .ds-bars { display: grid; gap: 12px; } .ds-track { height: 14px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(28% 0.016 55); overflow: hidden; } .ds-fill { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; transform-origin: left center; transform: scaleX(var(--p)); } .ds-base { background: oklch(79% 0.145 68); } .ds-plan { background: oklch(80% 0.095 190); }

components.name: Action Item
components.description: Ruled list row: heading, amber pill tag, impact explained.
components.html:
Run a purifier in the bedroom Indoor

Cuts overnight exposure by an estimated 40 to 60 percent.
components.css: .ds-act { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding-block: 16px; border-top: 1px solid oklch(40% 0.016 60); color: oklch(84% 0.014 75); } .ds-act h4 { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px 12px; font: 650 1rem 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(94% 0.012 80); } .ds-tag { padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(79% 0.145 68) 22%, oklch(22.5% 0.014 55)); color: oklch(79% 0.145 68); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-impact { margin: 0; color: oklch(94% 0.012 80); }

narrative.overview: The page is a room filled with the air it reports on. A fixed canvas of drifting smoke clouds sits behind everything, and its density is today's real AQI. The headline letters begin as blurred smog and resolve to sharp type. Building a plan visibly thins the haze by the estimated exposure cut. Panels are lightness steps of the same warm brown-grey, never glass or cards on cards. Dusk smog, ember light, cautious hope.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, warm brown-grey ground at L about 18%, pale warm ink.
One action colour (amber) and one cool colour (teal) that means only clean or improved.
Gloock display serif over Hanken Grotesk body; the AQI numeral is display-serif scale.
Flat: depth from lightness steps, hairlines and the smoke, not shadows.
Motion is atmospheric and every piece has a pause and a reduced-motion path.

rules.name: The Teal Means Clean Rule
rules.body: Teal marks only clean or improved air. It is never an accent, link or decoration.

rules.name: The Data Colours Rule
rules.body: The six CPCB colours are data: number, band, bar. Never buttons, borders or ornament, and the category word always accompanies them.

rules.name: The One Sun Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only action colour. A second warm accent is prohibited.

rules.name: The Display Is Serif Rule
rules.body: Headings and the AQI numeral are Gloock at weight 400 with font synthesis off; never faux-bold the display face.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and tags are sentence case at natural tracking. All-caps letterspaced kickers or eyebrows are not part of this system.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry no shadow at rest or on hover. State changes are colour mixes and a 1px press translate.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: Panels are 84% mixes of the raised ground, with no backdrop-filter and no cards nested in cards.

dos: Do keep the smoke density bound to the live AQI and let it thin when a plan is built.
Do pair every AQI colour with its category word or number; never colour alone.
Do use amber (oklch(79% 0.145 68)) for the single primary action per view and teal (oklch(80% 0.095 190)) only for clean or improved air.
Do build depth from the three ground steps (L 18%, 22.5%, 28%) and 1px hairlines.
Do keep targets at least 44px (buttons 48px) and body at 4.5:1 or better on the ground.
Do keep a pause control and a reduced-motion path for every animation; reduced motion shows text at rest and smoke still.
Do label estimates as approximate and keep safety messages prominent and unanimated.
donts: Don't arrange the page as a dashboard of cards, or nest cards in cards.
Don't use glass, backdrop-filter or drop shadows.
Don't use the CPCB data colours for buttons, borders or decoration.
Don't use teal as a general accent or link colour.
Don't set all-caps letterspaced kickers or eyebrows above headings.
Don't invent statistics, testimonials or logos.
Don't animate blur on more than the hero headline and results title.
Don't introduce a second display face or a light theme without a deliberate system change.
